name: Shrimp Trawler
prerequisites: Acrobatics: Balance[2], your character is from a town bordering the Lake of Western Lights
description: You own a shrimp trawler business, and use this to make good money on the shores of the Lake of Western Lights.

effects.name: Stilts
effects.text: You have a set of stilts which occupy 2 RIS. Though normally used for your business, you can equip or unequip them in combat from your RIS using an action if your are outdoors or under a high ceiling. If you do, halve your max. Move Speed. You cannot 5ft adjust or take cover when you have Stilts equipped. Gain Height advantage against Medium creatures at your level.

effects.name: Shrimp Trawling
effects.text: You can only Shrimp Trawl when you take a Long Rest in a town bordering the Lake of Western Lights. When you use the Earn Money action and trawl for shrimp, you gain 60gc per week.

name: Minor Boriand
description: Through political questions (or those of your family), you have been granted the title of Boriand, or mayor, of a small town by your local noble.

effects.name: Township’s Rule
effects.text: You have been granted the Boriandship of a small town. Work with your GM to define which Noble to whom you owe allegiance, and the town for which you are mayor. Every long rest, if you have 0 Influence in your town, gain 1 influence you can expend to support your town. If your Noble requires anything of you, you will also be expected to support them.

name: Stonecutter
description: You are a professional stoneworker, and can use your craft to create stones to support the wall effort.

effects.name: Stonecutting
effects.text: You can use your stonework to earn money. When you take the Earn Money Long Rest Action, you can use Construction:Stonework instead of taking an Odd Job. If you do, roll a 1X Disadvantaged Construction:Stonework Check. Then, consult the Ingredient Rarity chart. The money you earn from your work is not based on your Proficiency. Instead, it is based on the Rarity level of the item in the Ingredient Rarity Chart (i.e., if you roll a 21, corresponding to the Check DC to incorporate a Very Rare, Level 4 ingredient, gain gold from the Odd Job table corresponding to Proficiency 4 (100gp).

name: Red Glyph of Armor
description: A small piece of heavy paper, upon which a detailed Tianqi glyph emblazons the word “Protection”. It is written in blood.

effects.name: Armor of Blood
effects.text: Every Long Rest, denote PD, TD, or MD. Until the next long rest, gain +1 to that stat. You may change your selection over a long rest. Keep this Glyph in your RIS.

effects.name: Glyph Corruption
effects.text: When you attune to this item, you permanently gain 1 Glyph Corruption (randomly). You retain this Glyph Corruption if you remove Attunement to this Glyph.

name: Red Glyph of Hiding
description: A small piece of heavy paper, upon which a detailed Tianqi glyph emblazons the word “Stealth”. It is written in blood.

effects.name: Hidden Blood
effects.text: Whenever you use the Stealth: Hiding Talent, roll 1D6 and add it to your roll provided this Glyph is in your RIS.

effects.name: Glyph Corruption
effects.text: When you attune to this item, you permanently gain 1 Glyph Corruption (randomly). You retain this Glyph Corruption if you remove Attunement to this Glyph.

name: Red Glyph of Strength
description: A small piece of heavy paper, upon which a detailed Tianqi glyph emblazons the word “Power”. It is written in blood.

effects.name: Strength of Blood
effects.text: Choose one weapon to which this Glyph applies when it is in your RIS. Increase the damage dice of that weapon by 1 Dice Type. Additionally, it overcomes Nonmagical Damage Resistance.

effects.name: Glyph Corruption
effects.text: When you attune to this item, you permanently gain 1 Glyph Corruption (randomly). You retain this Glyph Corruption if you remove Attunement to this Glyph.

name: Red Glyph of Farsight
description: A small piece of heavy paper, upon which a detailed Tianqi glyph emblazons the word “Farsight”. It is written in blood.

effects.name: Hallowed Blood
effects.text: You cannot be Surprised when this Glyph is in your RIS.

effects.name: Glyph Corruption
effects.text: When you attune to this item, you permanently gain 1 Glyph Corruption (randomly). You retain this Glyph Corruption if you remove Attunement to this Glyph.

name: Red Glyph of Luck
description: A small piece of heavy paper, upon which a detailed Tianqi glyph emblazons the word “Fate”. It is written in blood.

effects.name: Type AB+ Blood
effects.text: This item has one charge. You may expend one charge to re-roll any 1D20 roll you make, provided you keep this item in your RIS. This item recovers one charge per Nightly Rest.

effects.name: Glyph Corruption
effects.text: When you attune to this item, you permanently gain 1 Glyph Corruption (randomly). You retain this Glyph Corruption if you remove Attunement to this Glyph.

name: Red Glyph of Promise
description: A small piece of heavy paper, upon which a detailed Tianqi glyph emblazons the word “Love”. It is written in blood.

effects.name: Shared Blood
effects.text: When you buy this glyph, choose a willing target. Both of you put your names on the glyph, rip it in half, attune to it, and store it in your RIS. You may both use the Help Action from 30ft away instead of 5ft on one another for as long as you are both attuned to this and the glyph is in your RIS.

effects.name: Glyph Corruption
effects.text: When you attune to this item, you permanently gain 1 Glyph Corruption (randomly). You retain this Glyph Corruption if you remove Attunement to this Glyph.

name: Eye of Insanity
description: A stone wrapped in papers. Each paper has an eye scrawled on it in deep black ink.

effects.name: Open the Insane Eye
effects.text: You open the eye and immediately go insane. Set your Madness to 6. Your madness is Irrecoverable until you drop to Unconsciousness. If there are no enemies visible within range, you use your full turn to attack your allies as best you are able until you drop to unconsciousness or die.

name: Pigsqueak Poison
description: A vibrant purple paste sits within a small pot. There are about four doses.

effects.name: Pigsqueak Poison
effects.text: If you consume this poison, you immediately make Power Checks against 4 levels of Frenzy. Additionally, for one minute, you go blind.

name: Noble Blood
description: You have inherited the greatest gift of the Tianqi - genetic lineage from the Ascendants themselves.

effects.name: Touching Gold
effects.text: Through your divine blood, you can touch and interact with gold.

effects.name: Commanding Presence
effects.text: People tend to listen to you, and you have a commanding presence. If you are a soldier, gain 1 extra Call Point beginning at Level 6.

effects.name: Boriand’s Blessing
effects.text: Beginning at Level 11, you gain the notice of nobility. You are given a minor Boriandship. Gain 1 Influence with a Tianqi City of your choosing.

name: Tiquil’s Psionic Glyphbinder
description: A small paper glyph, wrapped around a cloth clasp, bearing the family sigil of Tiquil, the lordship of Kjerstwall.

effects.name: Glyphbinding
effects.text: When you are within 5ft of a creature, you may clasp this to them with an action. They may fight the effect with a Finesse Check made against your Check DC. If they fail, Immediately, any telepathic connection they have with another creature, including all Fatebound connections, are immediately severed for as long as the clasp is on their body. If a Fatebound loses connection to their Binder, they immediately take levels of Fatigue equal to their Proficiency (no Trait Checks against the effect, max: 6). The clasp can be easily destroyed with an action, renewing the connection one round after the severing.

name: Wailing Pigsqueak
description: A blue Pigsqueak flower. Though lesser pigsqueak is said to give hallucinations, this pigsqueak is said to have more potent effects.

name: Dessicated Ascendant Finger
description: A crooked, bony finger of the long-dead Ascendant Aromon, who beat a demon general to death with his own arm.

name: Demon General Blood
description: The cursed blood of a demon general, in a small vial.

name: Rattling Bones
description: A necklace made of rattling bones, it jangles when you move, providing a comforting sound.

effects.name: Rattle the Bones
effects.text: When you maintain Focus on the Rattling Bones and you are wearing them, they soothe you. For as long as you maintain Focus, you are immune to Panic that would be given to you. If you already have Panic, gain 1X Advantage to all Trait Checks you make to remove this Panic.

name: Paperglyph
description: A protective paper glyph, with a sticky back, allowing you to slap it right on armor. The glyph shows a shield, with some details.

effects.name: Rendproof
effects.text: This item has 2 charges. When you take any levels of Rend to your armor, instead remove one charge from this item. You may refill a charge with 50gp at any market, but it does not charge on its own.
